name: bld4_permMatrix_involution_rank_fixed_points
statement: (K : Type*) [Field K] [CharZero K] (ι : Type*) [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] (σ : Equiv.Perm ι) (hσ : σ * σ = 1) : 2 * (1 + σ.permMatrix K).rank = Fintype.card ι + (Finset.univ.filter (fun i : ι => σ i = i)).card
closed: ∀ (K : Type*) [Field K] [CharZero K] (ι : Type*) [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] (σ : Equiv.Perm ι) (hσ : σ * σ = 1), 2 * (1 + σ.permMatrix K).rank = Fintype.card ι + (Finset.univ.filter (fun i : ι => σ i = i)).card
informal: Uses Mathlib2.bld_involution_trace_rank: the permutation matrix P of an involution satisfies P * P = 1 (Matrix.permMatrix_mul), so bld_involution_trace_rank gives tr P + n = 2 rank(1 + P) in K; tr P is the number of fixed points of σ (diagonal entries are 1 or 0), and Nat.cast injectivity in characteristic 0 gives the identity in ℕ.
type: ∀ (K : Type u_1) [inst : Field K] [CharZero K] (ι : Type u_2) [inst_2 : Fintype ι] [inst_3 : DecidableEq ι] (σ : Equiv.Perm ι), σ * σ = 1 → 2 * (1 + Equiv.Perm.permMatrix K σ).rank = Fintype.card ι + {i | σ i = i}.card
